notablePrerequisites:
Bear Umbra attached to Najeela.
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to kill Najeela.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
description:
Declare Najeela as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Najeela and Bear Umbra triggers.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Bear Umbra trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
